bullets: Added a /byok slash command (with /provider alias) for running inference through the user's own OpenRouter or OpenAI-compatible provider.
Added a confirm step when Freebucks balance refresh is unavailable, requiring spending consent before the meter is admitted.
Allowed switching from hosted inference to a personal provider once during a resumed run, while blocking reversions.
Added iOS ad placements as a distinct surface in the placements rail.
Removed the CLI utility that formatted validation errors with relative paths and clickable links.
Raised the default postpaid advertiser credit line to $200 and set a $100 collection threshold.
Added the Gravity Showcase experiment assignment and presentation telemetry.
